purpose: Verify which RF signed-error metrics can inform a probabilistic RF-vs-DR distance advantage decision; B stage ONLY.
rf_likelihood_fit: Gaussian signed error by channel/calibration fitted from other routes only; THIS IS A MODEL DIAGNOSTIC, NOT independent calibrated emission likelihood
evaluation_scope: Route holdout metrics are exploratory: overlapping RF positions, 0.5m spatial split R2/R5 infeasible
repeated_seed_note: RF scene repeats across gyro conditions and seeds; not independent RF environments.

statistical_hypotheses.H1: Signed RF residual bias/tail and conditional dispersion vary across observable range groups
statistical_hypotheses.H2: RF-only quality cannot uniquely determine RF>DR superiority; model requires DR error distribution and observed delta
statistical_hypotheses.H3: Source-uncalibrated fault-prior assumptions may produce poor group calibration despite math-consistent posterior
statistical_hypotheses.H4: Fully independent RF signed distribution calibration is not established by current overlapping three routes

claim_limits: No online CIR-quality fit from archived signed dataset
No production RF likelihood from observed-range-conditioned residual bins
policy: Preflight source SHA and frozen artifact SHA; independent numeric scalar integration in fixture, then read-only archived audit.
